chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah informed me of it, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from al-Sakuni, from Jafar, from his father, from Ali عليه السلام, that he was asked about a man who is in...

in the midst of the crowd on Friday or on the Day of Arafah, unable to leave the mosque because of the large number of people, and he breaks his wudu (ablution). He said: He performs tayammum and prays with them, then repeats when he departs.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day of congregational prayer
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: the Day of Arafah during hajj
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: he performs tayammum as dry ablution
key_terms.يَحْدُثُ: he enters a state requiring renewed ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he loses wudu (ablution) in a crowded mosque on Friday or the Day of Arafah and cannot get out?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for someone caught in a dense crowd in the mosque on Friday or the Day of Arafah who loses wudu (ablution) and cannot exit due to the press of people. He is instructed to perform tayammum, join the congregational salat (prayer), and then repeat the prayer after leaving.
